question: Add a limits[].kind for a concurrency cap (suggested term concurrency-cap) and one for a user count (suggested term user-cap), with the same two terms in binding, then move into limits[] the caps that limits_note holds: Ably Free 200 concurrent connections, 200 concurrent channels, 200 channels per connection, 5 queues per account and 50,000 queued messages across them; Pusher Sandbox 100 concurrent connections; PubNub Free 200 monthly active users and 10 active keysets; CloudAMQP Little Lemur 20 connections, 100 queues, 10 000 queued messages, 200 channels per connection and 200 consumers per channel; CloudAMQP Loyal Lemming 40 connections, 200 queues, 20 000 queued messages, 200 channels per connection and 200 consumers per channel.
why: AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12: the seven kinds bound calls, bytes, objects and time, none bounds how many connections, channels, consumers, queued messages or users are live at once, and a lane cannot add a kind. The binding constraint of each record is still its message count.
